strings.scene.xizhou.zhougong.title: 金縢
strings.scene.xizhou.zhougong.subtitle: 周公东征
strings.vo.01: 克商后二年，武王有疾。周公设坛于南方，作册告于三王。
strings.vo.02: 他请以自己代武王去死。册书藏在金縢之匮中。
strings.vo.03: 武王崩，成王年幼，周公摄政。管叔、蔡叔流言于国：周公将不利于孺子。
strings.vo.04: 三监挟武庚而叛。周公东征，三年乃定。
strings.vo.05: 那一年秋天，天降雷电大风——
strings.scene.xizhou.zhougong.quote: 惟朕小子其新逆，我国家礼亦宜之。
strings.scene.xizhou.zhougong.fork.prompt: 金縢——依《尚书》直书，还是听异说「桐叶封弟」？
strings.scene.xizhou.zhougong.pick.canon: 正史 · 《尚书·金縢》《史记·鲁周公世家》所载
strings.scene.xizhou.zhougong.canon.intro: 流言比叛军先到。周公对太公、召公说：我之所以不避嫌，是怕天下叛周。
strings.scene.xizhou.zhougong.end.canon: 七年，成王长，周公还政，北面就群臣之位。后来成王启金縢之书，执书以泣，亲自出郊迎周公。
strings.scene.xizhou.zhougong.legend.disclaimer: 以下是先秦两汉书中关于“天子无戏言”的不同记载：说这话的人，一说是周公，一说是史佚。后世还有人怀疑此事。
strings.scene.xizhou.zhougong.legend.intro: 成王与幼弟叔虞玩耍，削桐叶为珪，说：拿这个封你。有人进言：天子无戏言。于是封叔虞于唐。
strings.scene.xizhou.zhougong.end.legend: 叔虞封于唐，后为晋国之始。说话的人不同，封国的结果相同，汇流回周公还政之后。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：橄榄绿、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

narration: 克商后二年，武王有疾。周公设坛于南方，作册告于三王。
他请以自己代武王去死。册书藏在金縢之匮中。
武王崩，成王年幼，周公摄政。管叔、蔡叔流言于国：周公将不利于孺子。
三监挟武庚而叛。周公东征，三年乃定。
那一年秋天，天降雷电大风——
七年，成王长，周公还政，北面就群臣之位。后来成王启金縢之书，执书以泣，亲自出郊迎周公。
惟朕小子其新逆，我国家礼亦宜之。

[Ink-wash video prompt] Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE) · The Metal Casket: the Duke of Zhou's Eastern Campaign (「金縢」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 50 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), 1042 BCE–1036 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

Characters:
- Zhou Gongdan (周公旦) — royal / consort, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Zhou Chengwang (周成王) — ruler, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; a teenager
- Guan Shuxian (管叔鲜) — royal / consort, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Wu Genglufu (武庚禄父) — royal / consort, Shang; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Cai Shudu (蔡叔度) — royal / consort, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Shao Gong Shi (召公奭) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Tai Gongwang (太公望) — general, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–7 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, palace pillars, palace eaves | Action: Candlelight flickers in the palace at Feng and Hao | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「金縢」 with vermilion seal 「金縢之匮」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「克商后二年，武王有疾。周公设坛于南方，作册告于三王。」
Shot 2 (7–14 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: 册; subject: Zhou Gongdan, banners | Action: King Wu falls ill; the Duke of Zhou sets up an altar and writes a prayer | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他请以自己代武王去死。册书藏在金縢之匮中。」
Shot 3 (14–22 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Zhou Chengwang, Guan Shuxian, crowd | Action: King Cheng is a child; rumours spread through the realm | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「惟朕小子其新逆，我国家礼亦宜之。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「武王崩，成王年幼，周公摄政。管叔、蔡叔流言于国：周公将不利于孺子。」
Shot 4 (22–28 s, 6 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Wu Genglufu, army ranks, forest of spears, spear | Action: Three years of campaigning east of Yin | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; rows of pale ink figures fading into distance; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: distant drums, clashing weapons | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「三监挟武庚而叛。周公东征，三年乃定。」
Shot 5 (28–34 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: dry-brush calligraphy 「雨」「金縢一启」 | Action: Thunder, lightning and wind flatten the crops; the metal casket is opened | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; fine slanted strokes for rain; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: storm; SFX: rolling thunder | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「那一年秋天，天降雷电大风——」
Shot 6 (34–44 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: After seven years the Duke returns power; King Cheng reads the prayer, weeps and welcomes him in person. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「七年，成王长，周公还政，北面就群臣之位。后来成王启金縢之书，执书以泣，亲自出郊迎周公。」
Shot 7 (44–50 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「惟朕小子其新逆，我国家礼亦宜之。」 signed 《尚书·金縢》; vermilion seal 「金縢之匮」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「惟朕小子其新逆，我国家礼亦宜之。」

Sound: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: palace hall reverb, crowd murmur, distant battle, storm; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, murmuring, distant drums, clashing weapons, rolling thunder; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「金縢」, subtitle 「周公东征」, vermilion seal 「金縢之匮」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「惟朕小子其新逆，我国家礼亦宜之。」 — 《尚书·金縢》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.title: 宅兹中国
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.subtitle: 营建成周
strings.vo.01: 武王克商以后曾说，要在天下的中心建一座城，从那里治理百姓。他没来得及做，就去世了。
strings.vo.02: 成王即位，召公先到洛水边察看地形，用龟甲卜问城址。
strings.vo.03: 周公随后来到，再卜，在洛水东西两侧营建新邑，称为成周。
strings.vo.04: 成王五年，王迁居成周，在京室里对宗族子弟训话，提起了武王当年的话。
strings.vo.05: 一个名叫何的年轻人，回去以后铸了一件尊——
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.quote: 此天下之中，四方入贡道里均。
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.fork.prompt: 宅兹中国——依《尚书》直书，还是听后世「土圭测影求地中」？
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《尚书·召诰》《洛诰》与何尊铭文所载
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.canon.intro: “中国”这两个字最早出现在哪里？不在书上，在一件三千年前的青铜酒器里。
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.end.canon: 成周落成，九鼎迁居于此。何尊的一百二十二字铭文里，第一次出现了“中国”——天下的中心。
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.pick.legend: 后世 · 土圭测影求地中
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《周礼·地官·大司徒》“以土圭之法测土深，正日景，以求地中”，以及后世以河南登封告成镇为周公测景处的传说（今存唐代所立“周公测景台”石表）。《周礼》成书年代有争议，这些是后世的附会与追述。
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.legend.intro: 夏至正午，一根八尺的表杆立在地上。影子的长度，恰好是一尺五寸。
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.end.legend: 不论是卜出来的，还是量出来的，成周都被当作了天下的中心。
strings.scene.xizhou.hezun.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若成周建在别处（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：橄榄绿、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

shots.en: Shot 5 (34–40 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 宅兹中国; dry-brush calligraphy 「中国」 | Action: Inside a bronze vessel four characters are cast: 'dwelling in the centre' | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「一个名叫何的年轻人，回去以后铸了一件尊——」

shots.vo: 成周落成，九鼎迁居于此。何尊的一百二十二字铭文里，第一次出现了“中国”——天下的中心。

shots.en: Shot 6 (40–50 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Chengzhou is completed; the He zun inscription contains the first known use of 'zhongguo', the centre of the world. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「成周落成，九鼎迁居于此。何尊的一百二十二字铭文里，第一次出现了“中国”——天下的中心。」

narration: 武王克商以后曾说，要在天下的中心建一座城，从那里治理百姓。他没来得及做，就去世了。
成王即位，召公先到洛水边察看地形，用龟甲卜问城址。
周公随后来到，再卜，在洛水东西两侧营建新邑，称为成周。
成王五年，王迁居成周，在京室里对宗族子弟训话，提起了武王当年的话。
一个名叫何的年轻人，回去以后铸了一件尊——
成周落成，九鼎迁居于此。何尊的一百二十二字铭文里，第一次出现了“中国”——天下的中心。
此天下之中，四方入贡道里均。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE) · Dwelling in the Centre: Building Chengzhou (「宅兹中国」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 56 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), c. 1038 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

Characters:
- Zhou Chengwang (周成王) — ruler, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence
- Zhou Gongdan (周公旦) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Shao Gong Shi (召公奭) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- He (何) — commoner, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, clouds; midground: river | Action: Morning mist between the Luo and Yi rivers | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; clouds as moving pale wash; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「宅兹中国」 with vermilion seal 「中国」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「武王克商以后曾说，要在天下的中心建一座城，从那里治理百姓。他没来得及做，就去世了。」
Shot 2 (10–17 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river; subject: Shao Gong Shi, fire (splashed ink) | Action: The Duke of Shao divines the city site with turtle shells by the river | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; splashed ink flames tipped with vermilion; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: cracking oracle bone | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「成王即位，召公先到洛水边察看地形，用龟甲卜问城址。」
Shot 3 (17–25 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: map scroll, sand; subject: Zhou Gongdan | Action: The Duke of Zhou holds a plan and measures the line of the walls | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; dry-brush scumbled sand | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「此天下之中，四方入贡道里均。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「周公随后来到，再卜，在洛水东西两侧营建新邑，称为成周。」
Shot 4 (25–34 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhou Chengwang | Action: The new city is finished; King Cheng instructs the young clansmen in the hall | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; scorched-ink outline of battlements; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「成王五年，王迁居成周，在京室里对宗族子弟训话，提起了武王当年的话。」
Shot 5 (34–40 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 宅兹中国; dry-brush calligraphy 「中国」 | Action: Inside a bronze vessel four characters are cast: 'dwelling in the centre' | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「一个名叫何的年轻人，回去以后铸了一件尊——」
Shot 6 (40–50 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Chengzhou is completed; the He zun inscription contains the first known use of 'zhongguo', the centre of the world. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「成周落成，九鼎迁居于此。何尊的一百二十二字铭文里，第一次出现了“中国”——天下的中心。」
Shot 7 (50–56 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「此天下之中，四方入贡道里均。」 signed 《史记·周本纪》; vermilion seal 「中国」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「此天下之中，四方入贡道里均。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, quiet room tone; SFX: cracking oracle bone, bamboo slips rustling, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「宅兹中国」, subtitle 「营建成周」, vermilion seal 「中国」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「此天下之中，四方入贡道里均。」 — 《史记·周本纪》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.title: 甘棠
strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.subtitle: 召公
strings.vo.01: 周公和召公以陕为界，分治天下：陕以东归周公，陕以西归召公。
strings.vo.02: 召公巡行乡邑，遇到一棵棠树，就在树下审理案子、处理政事。
strings.vo.03: 从诸侯到平民，都各得其所，没有人失职。
strings.vo.04: 召公死后，百姓思念他，舍不得砍伐那棵棠树。
strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.quote: 蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。
strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.fork.prompt: 甘棠——依《史记》直书，还是听出土「克罍与燕国始封」？
strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《史记·燕召公世家》所载
strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.canon.intro: 一棵树，一张席，一位太保。召公不在官署里办事，他到百姓中间去。
strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.end.canon: 召公卒，民人思召公之政，怀棠树不敢伐，作《甘棠》之诗。召公的封国是燕，后来成为战国七雄之一。
strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.pick.legend: 出土 · 克罍与燕国始封
strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.legend.disclaimer: 以下取 1986 年北京房山琉璃河燕国墓地出土的克罍、克盉铭文：王命“克”侯于匽。学者多以为克是召公之子，即燕国实际的第一代君主；《史记》只说召公封于燕。这是考古所见的异说，具体人物关系仍有争论。
strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.legend.intro: 琉璃河的一座大墓里，出土了一件青铜罍。盖内与器口各铸着四十余字，说王命一个叫克的人去做匽侯。
strings.scene.xizhou.gantang.end.legend: 召公留在王畿辅政，儿子北上就封。甘棠下的召伯与琉璃河的匽侯，是同一个家族。

画风：写意水墨，焦墨—浓墨—淡墨分层次，枯笔飞白与泼墨墨点飞溅，笔触边缘自然晕开；点缀色（用量克制，只作点睛）：黑色 #1a1a1a、橄榄绿 #a8c848、驼色 #d2a997。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：4×3 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 远山（淡墨）；2. 近坡（中墨）；3. 土坡地线；4. 草丛（枯笔）。
第 2 行：5. 屋舍内景；6. 竹简书卷；7. 灯烛；8. 案几。
第 3 行：9. 树；10. 树冠；11. 草；12. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：2048×1536 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：橄榄绿、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 西周 · （约前 11 世纪）。宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。
setting.en: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), c. 1035 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

shots.vo: 周公和召公以陕为界，分治天下：陕以东归周公，陕以西归召公。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：树、树冠、草｜动作：陕地的原野，一株棠梨开着白花｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：鸟鸣｜屏幕文字：片名「甘棠」竖排书法与朱印「甘棠」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「周公和召公以陕为界，分治天下：陕以东归周公，陕以西归召公。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: trees, tree canopy, grass | Action: A pear tree in white blossom on the plain of Shan | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: birdsong | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「甘棠」 with vermilion seal 「甘棠」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「周公和召公以陕为界，分治天下：陕以东归周公，陕以西归召公。」

shots.vo: 召公巡行乡邑，遇到一棵棠树，就在树下审理案子、处理政事。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–16 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：树、树冠；主体：召公奭、众人｜动作：召公坐在树下，听两家人争地｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：树叶沙沙｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「召公巡行乡邑，遇到一棵棠树，就在树下审理案子、处理政事。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Shao Gong Shi, crowd | Action: The Duke of Shao sits beneath it hearing a land dispute | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: rustling leaves | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「召公巡行乡邑，遇到一棵棠树，就在树下审理案子、处理政事。」

shots.vo: 从诸侯到平民，都各得其所，没有人失职。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（16–22 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面；主体：召公奭｜动作：他走遍乡邑，不住官舍｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：引文「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「从诸侯到平民，都各得其所，没有人失职。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (16–22 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: Shao Gong Shi | Action: He travels through every village and never stays in official lodgings | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「从诸侯到平民，都各得其所，没有人失职。」

shots.vo: 召公死后，百姓思念他，舍不得砍伐那棵棠树。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（22–28 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：树、树冠；主体：乡邑之民｜动作：多年以后，有人举着斧头走向那棵树｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：伐木｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「召公死后，百姓思念他，舍不得砍伐那棵棠树。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (22–28 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Xiang Yizhimin | Action: Years later someone walks toward the tree with an axe | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: wood chopping | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「召公死后，百姓思念他，舍不得砍伐那棵棠树。」

shots.vo: 有人编了一首歌——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（28–34 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：树、树冠；主体：众人；飞白题字「勿翦勿伐」｜动作：斧头停在半空，乡人唱起了歌｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：鸟鸣；音效：树叶沙沙｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「有人编了一首歌——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (28–34 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: crowd; dry-brush calligraphy 「勿翦勿伐」 | Action: The axe stops mid-air as villagers begin to sing | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: birdsong; SFX: rustling leaves | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「有人编了一首歌——」

shots.vo: 召公卒，民人思召公之政，怀棠树不敢伐，作《甘棠》之诗。召公的封国是燕，后来成为战国七雄之一。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（34–45 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：召公卒，民人思召公之政，怀棠树不敢伐，作《甘棠》之诗。召公的封国是燕，后来成为战国七雄之一。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「召公卒，民人思召公之政，怀棠树不敢伐，作《甘棠》之诗。召公的封国是燕，后来成为战国七雄之一。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (34–45 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The people remember the Duke's rule, refuse to cut the tree, and compose the ode 'Gantang'. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「召公卒，民人思召公之政，怀棠树不敢伐，作《甘棠》之诗。召公的封国是燕，后来成为战国七雄之一。」

shots.vo: 蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」，下署《诗经·召南·甘棠》；右下角朱印「甘棠」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」 signed 《诗经·召南·甘棠》; vermilion seal 「甘棠」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：鸟鸣、人群低语、旷野风声；音效：树叶沙沙、脚步声、伐木；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: birdsong, crowd murmur, wind over open plains; SFX: rustling leaves, footsteps, wood chopping; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「甘棠」，副题「召公」，朱印「甘棠」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」——《诗经·召南·甘棠》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「甘棠」, subtitle 「召公」, vermilion seal 「甘棠」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」 — 《诗经·召南·甘棠》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

negative.zh: 写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
negative.en: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

narration: 周公和召公以陕为界，分治天下：陕以东归周公，陕以西归召公。
召公巡行乡邑，遇到一棵棠树，就在树下审理案子、处理政事。
从诸侯到平民，都各得其所，没有人失职。
召公死后，百姓思念他，舍不得砍伐那棵棠树。
有人编了一首歌——
召公卒，民人思召公之政，怀棠树不敢伐，作《甘棠》之诗。召公的封国是燕，后来成为战国七雄之一。
蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE) · The Pear Tree: the Duke of Shao (「甘棠」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 51 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), c. 1035 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

Characters:
- Shao Gong Shi (召公奭) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Xiang Yizhimin (乡邑之民) — commoner, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate
- Zhou Gongdan (周公旦) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Ke (克) — royal / consort, Yan; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: trees, tree canopy, grass | Action: A pear tree in white blossom on the plain of Shan | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: birdsong | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「甘棠」 with vermilion seal 「甘棠」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「周公和召公以陕为界，分治天下：陕以东归周公，陕以西归召公。」
Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Shao Gong Shi, crowd | Action: The Duke of Shao sits beneath it hearing a land dispute | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: rustling leaves | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「召公巡行乡邑，遇到一棵棠树，就在树下审理案子、处理政事。」
Shot 3 (16–22 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: Shao Gong Shi | Action: He travels through every village and never stays in official lodgings | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「从诸侯到平民，都各得其所，没有人失职。」
Shot 4 (22–28 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Xiang Yizhimin | Action: Years later someone walks toward the tree with an axe | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: wood chopping | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「召公死后，百姓思念他，舍不得砍伐那棵棠树。」
Shot 5 (28–34 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: crowd; dry-brush calligraphy 「勿翦勿伐」 | Action: The axe stops mid-air as villagers begin to sing | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: birdsong; SFX: rustling leaves | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「有人编了一首歌——」
Shot 6 (34–45 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The people remember the Duke's rule, refuse to cut the tree, and compose the ode 'Gantang'. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「召公卒，民人思召公之政，怀棠树不敢伐，作《甘棠》之诗。召公的封国是燕，后来成为战国七雄之一。」
Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」 signed 《诗经·召南·甘棠》; vermilion seal 「甘棠」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: birdsong, crowd murmur, wind over open plains; SFX: rustling leaves, footsteps, wood chopping; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「甘棠」, subtitle 「召公」, vermilion seal 「甘棠」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。」 — 《诗经·召南·甘棠》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

strings.scene.xizhou.zhaowang.title: 南征而不复
strings.scene.xizhou.zhaowang.subtitle: 周昭王
strings.vo.01: 周昭王的时候，王道已经有些衰微。
strings.vo.02: 古本《竹书纪年》说，昭王十六年，伐楚荆，渡汉水，遇见了大兕。
strings.vo.03: 十九年，天色昏暗，野鸡和野兔都惊惶不安，周王的六师丧于汉水。
strings.vo.04: 《史记》只写了一句：昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。周人没有向诸侯讣告，因为他们讳言此事。
strings.vo.05: 江心的那条船，开始散开——
strings.scene.xizhou.zhaowang.quote: 昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。
strings.scene.xizhou.zhaowang.fork.prompt: 南征而不复——依《史记》直书，还是听野史「胶舟」？
strings.scene.xizhou.zhaowang.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《史记·周本纪》与古本《竹书纪年》所载
strings.scene.xizhou.zhaowang.canon.intro: 一位周王死在南方的江水里，周人却不肯告诉诸侯。三百年后，齐国的管仲还拿这件事去问罪楚人。
strings.scene.xizhou.zhaowang.end.canon: 三百余年后的召陵之会，管仲说：昭王南征而不复，寡人是问。楚使答：昭王之不复，君其问诸水滨。齐楚终于议和。
strings.scene.xizhou.zhaowang.legend.disclaimer: 以下取晋皇甫谧《帝王世纪》（《史记·周本纪》正义引）：船人恶昭王，以胶粘合的船进王，船至中流，胶解船散，王与祭公俱没于水。这是后世的传说，解释昭王为何死于江上。
strings.scene.xizhou.zhaowang.legend.intro: 汉水渡口，船人献上一条新船，船板光亮如新。没有人注意到，木板之间抹的不是漆，是胶。
strings.scene.xizhou.zhaowang.end.legend: 船还是散了。传说给“卒于江上”补上了一个凶手，可周人自己什么也没说。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：橄榄绿、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 西周 · 昭王十九年（约前 977 年）。宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。
setting.en: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), c. 977 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

characters.name: 周昭王
characters.zh: 周昭王（周·周王）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩，皮甲与青铜戈；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；南巡狩不返，卒于江上
characters.en: Zhou Zhaowang (周昭王) — ruler, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence

shots.vo: 周昭王的时候，王道已经有些衰微。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–6 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、树、树冠｜动作：汉水宽阔，南岸是荆楚的山林｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水｜屏幕文字：片名「南征而不复」竖排书法与朱印「汉水」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「周昭王的时候，王道已经有些衰微。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, trees, tree canopy | Action: The broad Han River, Chu forests on the southern bank | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「南征而不复」 with vermilion seal 「汉水」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「周昭王的时候，王道已经有些衰微。」

shots.vo: 古本《竹书纪年》说，昭王十六年，伐楚荆，渡汉水，遇见了大兕。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（6–14 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：舟；主体：旌旗、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：周师的战船浩浩荡荡渡江｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；淡墨人影成排，远处虚化｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：摇橹｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「古本《竹书纪年》说，昭王十六年，伐楚荆，渡汉水，遇见了大兕。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (6–14 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: boat; subject: banners, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: The Zhou fleet crosses in great numbers | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; rows of pale ink figures fading into distance | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: oars | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「古本《竹书纪年》说，昭王十六年，伐楚荆，渡汉水，遇见了大兕。」

shots.vo: 十九年，天色昏暗，野鸡和野兔都惊惶不安，周王的六师丧于汉水。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（14–22 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：远景：云；中景：河水；主体：周昭王｜动作：天色忽然阴沉，鸟兽惊走｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；云气以淡墨晕染流动；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：暴风雨；音效：雷声｜屏幕文字：引文「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「十九年，天色昏暗，野鸡和野兔都惊惶不安，周王的六师丧于汉水。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (14–22 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: background: clouds; midground: river; subject: Zhou Zhaowang | Action: The sky darkens suddenly; birds and beasts flee | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; clouds as moving pale wash; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: storm; SFX: thunder | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「十九年，天色昏暗，野鸡和野兔都惊惶不安，周王的六师丧于汉水。」

shots.vo: 《史记》只写了一句：昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。周人没有向诸侯讣告，因为他们讳言此事。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（22–33 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：舟；主体：祭公、水｜动作：江心，一条船开始松散｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾｜声音：环境：海浪；音效：木裂｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「《史记》只写了一句：昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。周人没有向诸侯讣告，因为他们讳言此事。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (22–33 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: boat; subject: Ji Gong, water | Action: In midstream a boat starts coming apart | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake | Sound: ambience: sea waves; SFX: cracking wood | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「《史记》只写了一句：昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。周人没有向诸侯讣告，因为他们讳言此事。」

shots.vo: 江心的那条船，开始散开——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（33–39 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：河水；主体：旌旗；飞白题字「不复」｜动作：六师没入汉水，江面只剩旗帜｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：暴风雨；音效：水势奔涌｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「江心的那条船，开始散开——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (33–39 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river; subject: banners; dry-brush calligraphy 「不复」 | Action: Six armies sink into the Han; only banners float on the water | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: storm; SFX: surging water | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「江心的那条船，开始散开——」

shots.vo: 三百余年后的召陵之会，管仲说：昭王南征而不复，寡人是问。楚使答：昭王之不复，君其问诸水滨。齐楚终于议和。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（39–51 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：三百余年后的召陵之会，管仲说：昭王南征而不复，寡人是问。楚使答：昭王之不复，君其问诸水滨。齐楚终于议和。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「三百余年后的召陵之会，管仲说：昭王南征而不复，寡人是问。楚使答：昭王之不复，君其问诸水滨。齐楚终于议和。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (39–51 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Three centuries later Guan Zhong asks Chu about King Zhao, and Chu replies: ask the riverbank. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「三百余年后的召陵之会，管仲说：昭王南征而不复，寡人是问。楚使答：昭王之不复，君其问诸水滨。齐楚终于议和。」

shots.vo: 昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（51–57 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」，下署《史记·周本纪》；右下角朱印「汉水」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (51–57 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」 signed 《史记·周本纪》; vermilion seal 「汉水」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：平缓河水、暴风雨、海浪；音效：摇橹、雷声、木裂、水势奔涌；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, storm, sea waves; SFX: oars, thunder, cracking wood, surging water; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「南征而不复」，副题「周昭王」，朱印「汉水」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」——《史记·周本纪》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「南征而不复」, subtitle 「周昭王」, vermilion seal 「汉水」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」 — 《史记·周本纪》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

narration: 周昭王的时候，王道已经有些衰微。
古本《竹书纪年》说，昭王十六年，伐楚荆，渡汉水，遇见了大兕。
十九年，天色昏暗，野鸡和野兔都惊惶不安，周王的六师丧于汉水。
《史记》只写了一句：昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。周人没有向诸侯讣告，因为他们讳言此事。
江心的那条船，开始散开——
三百余年后的召陵之会，管仲说：昭王南征而不复，寡人是问。楚使答：昭王之不复，君其问诸水滨。齐楚终于议和。

【水墨视频生成提示词】西周 · 南征而不复（周昭王）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 57 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：橄榄绿、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。

时代与场景：西周 · 昭王十九年（约前 977 年）。宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。

人物：
- 周昭王（周·周王）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩，皮甲与青铜戈；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；南巡狩不返，卒于江上
- 祭公（周·周卿士）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；《帝王世纪》称与王俱没于水
- 楚子（楚·楚国之君）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩，皮甲与青铜戈；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；荆楚，昭王所伐
- 管仲（齐·齐相）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；三百余年后以“昭王南征而不复”责楚

分镜：
镜头 1（0–6 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、树、树冠｜动作：汉水宽阔，南岸是荆楚的山林｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水｜屏幕文字：片名「南征而不复」竖排书法与朱印「汉水」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「周昭王的时候，王道已经有些衰微。」
镜头 2（6–14 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：舟；主体：旌旗、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：周师的战船浩浩荡荡渡江｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；淡墨人影成排，远处虚化｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：摇橹｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「古本《竹书纪年》说，昭王十六年，伐楚荆，渡汉水，遇见了大兕。」
镜头 3（14–22 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：远景：云；中景：河水；主体：周昭王｜动作：天色忽然阴沉，鸟兽惊走｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；云气以淡墨晕染流动；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：暴风雨；音效：雷声｜屏幕文字：引文「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「十九年，天色昏暗，野鸡和野兔都惊惶不安，周王的六师丧于汉水。」
镜头 4（22–33 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：舟；主体：祭公、水｜动作：江心，一条船开始松散｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾｜声音：环境：海浪；音效：木裂｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「《史记》只写了一句：昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。周人没有向诸侯讣告，因为他们讳言此事。」
镜头 5（33–39 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：河水；主体：旌旗；飞白题字「不复」｜动作：六师没入汉水，江面只剩旗帜｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：暴风雨；音效：水势奔涌｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「江心的那条船，开始散开——」
镜头 6（39–51 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：三百余年后的召陵之会，管仲说：昭王南征而不复，寡人是问。楚使答：昭王之不复，君其问诸水滨。齐楚终于议和。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「三百余年后的召陵之会，管仲说：昭王南征而不复，寡人是问。楚使答：昭王之不复，君其问诸水滨。齐楚终于议和。」
镜头 7（51–57 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」，下署《史记·周本纪》；右下角朱印「汉水」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：平缓河水、暴风雨、海浪；音效：摇橹、雷声、木裂、水势奔涌；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「南征而不复」，副题「周昭王」，朱印「汉水」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」——《史记·周本纪》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE) · The King Who Never Returned: King Zhao (「南征而不复」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 57 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), c. 977 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

Characters:
- Zhou Zhaowang (周昭王) — ruler, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence
- Ji Gong (祭公) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Chu Zi (楚子) — ruler, Chu; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence
- Guan Zhong (管仲) — minister, Qi; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, trees, tree canopy | Action: The broad Han River, Chu forests on the southern bank | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「南征而不复」 with vermilion seal 「汉水」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「周昭王的时候，王道已经有些衰微。」
Shot 2 (6–14 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: boat; subject: banners, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: The Zhou fleet crosses in great numbers | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; rows of pale ink figures fading into distance | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: oars | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「古本《竹书纪年》说，昭王十六年，伐楚荆，渡汉水，遇见了大兕。」
Shot 3 (14–22 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: background: clouds; midground: river; subject: Zhou Zhaowang | Action: The sky darkens suddenly; birds and beasts flee | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; clouds as moving pale wash; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: storm; SFX: thunder | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「十九年，天色昏暗，野鸡和野兔都惊惶不安，周王的六师丧于汉水。」
Shot 4 (22–33 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: boat; subject: Ji Gong, water | Action: In midstream a boat starts coming apart | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake | Sound: ambience: sea waves; SFX: cracking wood | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「《史记》只写了一句：昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。周人没有向诸侯讣告，因为他们讳言此事。」
Shot 5 (33–39 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river; subject: banners; dry-brush calligraphy 「不复」 | Action: Six armies sink into the Han; only banners float on the water | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: storm; SFX: surging water | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「江心的那条船，开始散开——」
Shot 6 (39–51 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Three centuries later Guan Zhong asks Chu about King Zhao, and Chu replies: ask the riverbank. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「三百余年后的召陵之会，管仲说：昭王南征而不复，寡人是问。楚使答：昭王之不复，君其问诸水滨。齐楚终于议和。」
Shot 7 (51–57 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」 signed 《史记·周本纪》; vermilion seal 「汉水」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, storm, sea waves; SFX: oars, thunder, cracking wood, surging water; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「南征而不复」, subtitle 「周昭王」, vermilion seal 「汉水」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「昭王南巡狩不返，卒于江上。其卒不赴告，讳之也。」 — 《史记·周本纪》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.xizhou.muwang.title: 八骏
strings.scene.xizhou.muwang.subtitle: 穆王西巡
strings.vo.01: 周穆王即位时已五十岁。他要伐犬戎。
strings.vo.02: 祭公谋父进谏：先王耀德而不观兵。王不听，遂征之，得四白狼、四白鹿而归。
strings.vo.03: 自是荒服者不至。造父以善御得幸，为王驾骥、温骊、骅骝、騄耳之驷。
strings.scene.xizhou.muwang.fork.prompt: 八骏——依《史记》直书，还是听野史「瑶池之会」？

strings.scene.xizhou.muwang.pick.canon: 正史 · 《史记》周、秦本纪所载
strings.scene.xizhou.muwang.canon.intro: 祭公谋父说，伐犬戎只会让远方的人不再来朝。穆王还是上了车。
strings.scene.xizhou.muwang.end.canon: 造父长驱归周，以救其乱，穆王以赵城封造父。周的西方，从此荒服不至。
strings.scene.xizhou.muwang.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自汲冢出土的《穆天子传》和古本《竹书纪年》佚文，书中的西王母带有神话色彩，不是史实。
strings.scene.xizhou.muwang.legend.intro: 《穆天子传》说：穆王西登昆仑之丘，观黄帝之宫，又宾于西王母，觴于瑶池之上。
strings.scene.xizhou.muwang.end.legend: 西王母说“将子无死，尚能复来”。穆王东归，传说汇回史书里的那趟长驱归周。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：橄榄绿、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 西周 · （约前 976—前 922 年）。宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。
setting.en: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), 976 BCE–922 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

shots.vo: 周穆王即位时已五十岁。他要伐犬戎。

shots.vo: 祭公谋父进谏：先王耀德而不观兵。王不听，遂征之，得四白狼、四白鹿而归。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（6–15 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：祭公谋父、周穆王｜动作：祭公谋父进谏：先王耀德不观兵｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；重墨立柱，空间纵深｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「祭公谋父进谏：先王耀德而不观兵。王不听，遂征之，得四白狼、四白鹿而归。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (6–15 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Ji Gongmoufu, Zhou Muwang | Action: Zhai Gong Moufu warns: former kings showed virtue, not arms | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「祭公谋父进谏：先王耀德而不观兵。王不听，遂征之，得四白狼、四白鹿而归。」

shots.vo: 自是荒服者不至。造父以善御得幸，为王驾骥、温骊、骅骝、騄耳之驷。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（15–23 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：犬戎、骑兵、弓箭｜动作：征犬戎，得四白狼四白鹿｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：马蹄声、号角｜屏幕文字：引文「先王耀德不观兵。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「自是荒服者不至。造父以善御得幸，为王驾骥、温骊、骅骝、騄耳之驷。」

shots.vo: 东方传来急报——

narration: 周穆王即位时已五十岁。他要伐犬戎。
祭公谋父进谏：先王耀德而不观兵。王不听，遂征之，得四白狼、四白鹿而归。
自是荒服者不至。造父以善御得幸，为王驾骥、温骊、骅骝、騄耳之驷。
王西巡狩，乐而忘归。
东方传来急报——
造父长驱归周，以救其乱，穆王以赵城封造父。周的西方，从此荒服不至。
先王耀德不观兵。

strings.scene.xizhou.feizi.title: 汧渭之间
strings.scene.xizhou.feizi.subtitle: 非子养马
strings.vo.01: 秦人的祖先非子住在犬丘，喜欢马和牲畜，很会饲养繁殖。
strings.vo.02: 犬丘人把他推荐给周孝王。孝王召他在汧水和渭水之间主管养马，马匹大量繁殖。
strings.vo.03: 孝王想立非子为大骆的继承人，申侯却不同意，说大骆的嫡子成是申侯女儿所生，能保西戎和睦。
strings.vo.04: 孝王于是另想了一个办法。
strings.vo.05: 他说：从前伯益为舜主管牲畜，得到了封地——
strings.scene.xizhou.feizi.fork.prompt: 汧渭之间——依《史记》直书，还是听异说「秦人从东方来」？
strings.scene.xizhou.feizi.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《史记·秦本纪》所载
strings.scene.xizhou.feizi.canon.intro: 一个养马的人，得到了一块叫“秦”的小地方。六百多年后，他的后代统一了天下。
strings.scene.xizhou.feizi.end.canon: 孝王邑非子于秦，使复续嬴氏之祀，号曰秦嬴，作为周的附庸。大骆的嫡子成仍为继承人，西戎因此和睦。
strings.scene.xizhou.feizi.pick.legend: 异说 · 秦人从东方来
strings.scene.xizhou.feizi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《史记·秦本纪》开篇的族源神话（女脩吞玄鸟之卵而生大业），以及清华简《系年》第三章：成王伐商奄，迁商奄之民于邾吾（朱圉），以御奴之戎，是秦先人。这是神话与出土文献提供的不同来历，学界仍有讨论。
strings.scene.xizhou.feizi.legend.intro: 玄鸟落下一枚卵，女脩吞下，生了秦人的始祖。另一卷竹简上却写着：秦人的先祖，是被周王从东方迁来戍边的商奄之民。
strings.scene.xizhou.feizi.end.legend: 无论来自玄鸟还是来自东方，秦人最终在西陲扎下了根。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：橄榄绿、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.en: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), c. 888 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

shots.vo: 秦人的祖先非子住在犬丘，喜欢马和牲畜，很会饲养繁殖。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：草；主体：骑兵｜动作：犬丘的草原，马群在风中奔跑｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：片名「汧渭之间」竖排书法与朱印「秦嬴」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秦人的祖先非子住在犬丘，喜欢马和牲畜，很会饲养繁殖。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: grass; subject: cavalry | Action: Horses gallop in the wind on the Quanqiu grasslands | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「汧渭之间」 with vermilion seal 「秦嬴」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦人的祖先非子住在犬丘，喜欢马和牲畜，很会饲养繁殖。」

shots.vo: 犬丘人把他推荐给周孝王。孝王召他在汧水和渭水之间主管养马，马匹大量繁殖。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–18 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：非子、战马｜动作：一个年轻人挨个察看母马的肚腹｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：马嘶｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「犬丘人把他推荐给周孝王。孝王召他在汧水和渭水之间主管养马，马匹大量繁殖。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–18 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Fei Zi, war horse | Action: A young man checks the mares one by one | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: horse neigh | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「犬丘人把他推荐给周孝王。孝王召他在汧水和渭水之间主管养马，马匹大量繁殖。」

narration: 秦人的祖先非子住在犬丘，喜欢马和牲畜，很会饲养繁殖。
犬丘人把他推荐给周孝王。孝王召他在汧水和渭水之间主管养马，马匹大量繁殖。
孝王想立非子为大骆的继承人，申侯却不同意，说大骆的嫡子成是申侯女儿所生，能保西戎和睦。
孝王于是另想了一个办法。
他说：从前伯益为舜主管牲畜，得到了封地——
孝王邑非子于秦，使复续嬴氏之祀，号曰秦嬴，作为周的附庸。大骆的嫡子成仍为继承人，西戎因此和睦。
朕其分土为附庸。

strings.scene.xizhou.gonghe.title: 共和元年
strings.scene.xizhou.gonghe.subtitle: 国人暴动
strings.vo.01: 周厉王好利，近荣夷公。国人谤王。
strings.vo.02: 王怒，得卫巫，使监谤者，以告则杀之。
strings.vo.03: 国人莫敢言，道路以目。召公谏曰：防民之口，甚于防川。王不听。
strings.vo.04: 三年，国人相与畔，袭厉王。王出奔于彘。
strings.vo.05: 召公、周公二相行政，号曰共和——
strings.scene.xizhou.gonghe.fork.prompt: 共和元年——依《国语》直书，还是听异说「共伯和」？
strings.scene.xizhou.gonghe.canon.intro: 镐京的街上没人说话，人们相遇只用眼睛示意。召公知道，这种安静不会长久。
strings.scene.xizhou.gonghe.end.canon: 召公、周公共同行政，号曰共和。十四年后，厉王死于彘，太子静立，是为宣王。
strings.scene.xizhou.gonghe.legend.disclaimer: 以下是史料之间的分歧：“共和”是二公共同行政，还是共伯和摄政？各书说法不同。
strings.scene.xizhou.gonghe.legend.intro: 古本《竹书纪年》佚文说“共伯和干王位”；《吕氏春秋》《庄子》亦提及共伯。与《史记》“二相行政”之说不同。
strings.scene.xizhou.gonghe.end.legend: 无论是二公行政还是共伯摄政，十四年后宣王即位。两说同归一处。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：橄榄绿、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 西周 · 共和元年（前 841 年）。宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。
setting.en: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), 841 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE) · First Year of Gonghe: the People's Revolt (「共和元年」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 47 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), 841 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

Characters:
- Zhou Liwang (周厉王) — ruler, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence
- Rong Yigong (荣夷公) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Wei Wu (卫巫) — commoner, Wei; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate
- Shao Mugong (召穆公) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Zhou Dinggong (周定公) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Tai Zijing (太子静) — royal / consort, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Gong Bohe (共伯和) — ruler, Gong; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall | Action: Hao: people walk the streets in silence | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「共和元年」 with vermilion seal 「共和元年」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「周厉王好利，近荣夷公。国人谤王。」
Shot 2 (6–12 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhou Liwang, Rong Yigong | Action: King Li loves profit and trusts Duke Rong Yi | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「王怒，得卫巫，使监谤者，以告则杀之。」
Shot 3 (12–20 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Wei Wu, crowd | Action: A shaman of Wei watches for critics; people only exchange glances on the road | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「防民之口，甚于防川。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「国人莫敢言，道路以目。召公谏曰：防民之口，甚于防川。王不听。」
Shot 4 (20–26 s, 6 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: smoke; subject: crowd, fire (splashed ink) | Action: In the third year the people surround the palace | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; splashed ink flames tipped with vermilion; pale ink smoke drifting sideways; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: roaring crowd | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「三年，国人相与畔，袭厉王。王出奔于彘。」
Shot 5 (26–32 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 共和; dry-brush calligraphy 「共和元年」 | Action: The king flees to Zhi; two dukes govern | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: roaring crowd, bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「召公、周公二相行政，号曰共和——」
Shot 6 (32–41 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The dukes of Shao and Zhou rule jointly, called Gonghe; fourteen years later Li dies and King Xuan succeeds. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「召公、周公共同行政，号曰共和。十四年后，厉王死于彘，太子静立，是为宣王。」
Shot 7 (41–47 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「防民之口，甚于防川。」 signed 《国语·周语上》; vermilion seal 「共和元年」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「防民之口，甚于防川。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, crowd murmur, roaring crowd, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell, footsteps, roaring crowd; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「共和元年」, subtitle 「国人暴动」, vermilion seal 「共和元年」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「防民之口，甚于防川。」 — 《国语·周语上》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.xizhou.xuanwang.title: 薄伐玁狁
strings.scene.xizhou.xuanwang.subtitle: 宣王中兴
strings.vo.01: 共和十四年之后，太子静即位，就是周宣王。召公、周公二相辅佐他，重修文武之政。
strings.vo.02: 北方的玁狁屡屡南侵，甚至逼近了京畿。
strings.vo.03: 宣王五年三月，王亲自出征，伐玁狁。《诗经》里唱道：六月里军情紧急，戎车已经备好。
strings.vo.04: 卿士兮甲随王出征，斩首执讯，没有伤亡。
strings.vo.05: 他回来以后，铸了一个铜盘——
strings.scene.xizhou.xuanwang.fork.prompt: 薄伐玁狁——依《史记》直书，还是听出土「兮甲盘与多友鼎」？
strings.scene.xizhou.xuanwang.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《史记·周本纪》与《诗·小雅》所载
strings.scene.xizhou.xuanwang.canon.intro: 宣王即位的时候，周已经几乎被打垮了：国人暴动，王逃到彘，玁狁年年南下。他要把这个王朝重新扶起来。
strings.scene.xizhou.xuanwang.end.canon: 诸侯复宗周，史称宣王中兴。可是中兴之下，裂缝也在扩大：宣王不修籍田，不听谏言，三十九年千亩之战，王师败绩。
strings.scene.xizhou.xuanwang.pick.legend: 出土 · 兮甲盘与多友鼎
strings.scene.xizhou.xuanwang.legend.disclaimer: 以下取青铜器铭文：兮甲盘（宋代出土）记宣王五年伐玁狁，兮甲从王折首执讯，又受命管理成周与南淮夷的贡赋；多友鼎（1980 年陕西长安出土）记玁狁侵犯京师，多友率战车追击。多友鼎的年代有厉王、宣王两说。铭文与《诗经》互证，又补出不同的细节。
strings.scene.xizhou.xuanwang.legend.intro: 两件铜器，两场追击。一件铸着王的名号，一件铸着一个叫多友的将领，和他夺回的大批戎车。
strings.scene.xizhou.xuanwang.end.legend: 盘与鼎上的字，和《诗经》里的歌，讲的是同一场边境战争。

画风：写意水墨，焦墨—浓墨—淡墨分层次，枯笔飞白与泼墨墨点飞溅，笔触边缘自然晕开；点缀色（用量克制，只作点睛）：黑色 #1a1a1a、橄榄绿 #a8c848、驼色 #d2a997。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×3 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触；3. 蹄下墨尘。
第 2 行：4. 鬃毛飞扬；5. 风卷旗影；6. 突刺枪花。
第 3 行：7. 命中溅墨；8. 冲阵烟尘；9. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：1536×1536 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。
artPrompts.negative: 文字, 书法, 题字, 印章, 边框, 网格线, 底纹, 纸纹, 背景色, 白底, 阴影, 倒影, 水印, 写实照片, 3D 渲染, 厚涂, 现代器物, 现代服饰, 多余肢体, 五官崩坏

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：橄榄绿、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 西周 · 周宣王五年（前 823 年）。宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。
setting.en: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), 823 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

shots.vo: 共和十四年之后，太子静即位，就是周宣王。召公、周公二相辅佐他，重修文武之政。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：沙；主体：骑兵｜动作：北方的高原，玁狁的骑兵扬起尘土｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；干笔擦出沙地；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：片名「薄伐玁狁」竖排书法与朱印「中兴」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「共和十四年之后，太子静即位，就是周宣王。召公、周公二相辅佐他，重修文武之政。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: sand; subject: cavalry | Action: Xianyun horsemen raise dust on the northern plateau | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; dry-brush scumbled sand; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「薄伐玁狁」 with vermilion seal 「中兴」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「共和十四年之后，太子静即位，就是周宣王。召公、周公二相辅佐他，重修文武之政。」

shots.vo: 北方的玁狁屡屡南侵，甚至逼近了京畿。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–16 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：周宣王、旌旗｜动作：镐京，年轻的宣王披甲登车｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；重墨立柱，空间纵深｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「北方的玁狁屡屡南侵，甚至逼近了京畿。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–16 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhou Xuanwang, banners | Action: At Hao the young King Xuan dons armour and mounts his chariot | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北方的玁狁屡屡南侵，甚至逼近了京畿。」

shots.vo: 宣王五年三月，王亲自出征，伐玁狁。《诗经》里唱道：六月里军情紧急，戎车已经备好。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（16–26 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：军阵、长兵如林、骑兵、旌旗｜动作：战车六月出征，直抵太原｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；淡墨人影成排，远处虚化；枯笔竖线密如森林；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：战车｜屏幕文字：引文「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宣王五年三月，王亲自出征，伐玁狁。《诗经》里唱道：六月里军情紧急，戎车已经备好。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (16–26 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: army ranks, forest of spears, cavalry, banners | Action: In the sixth month the chariots ride out to Taiyuan | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; rows of pale ink figures fading into distance; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: chariots | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宣王五年三月，王亲自出征，伐玁狁。《诗经》里唱道：六月里军情紧急，戎车已经备好。」

shots.vo: 卿士兮甲随王出征，斩首执讯，没有伤亡。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（26–32 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：尹吉甫、众人、长枪｜动作：尹吉甫斩首执讯，押着俘虏归来｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：众人呐喊；音效：喊杀｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「卿士兮甲随王出征，斩首执讯，没有伤亡。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (26–32 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Yin Jifu, crowd, spear | Action: Yin Jifu returns with heads and captives | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: war cries | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「卿士兮甲随王出征，斩首执讯，没有伤亡。」

shots.vo: 他回来以后，铸了一个铜盘——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（32–38 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：伐玁狁；飞白题字「中兴」｜动作：铜盘上铸下了这一次出征｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：喊杀、青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他回来以后，铸了一个铜盘——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (32–38 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 伐玁狁; dry-brush calligraphy 「中兴」 | Action: The campaign is cast on a bronze basin | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: war cries, bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他回来以后，铸了一个铜盘——」

shots.vo: 诸侯复宗周，史称宣王中兴。可是中兴之下，裂缝也在扩大：宣王不修籍田，不听谏言，三十九年千亩之战，王师败绩。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（38–50 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：诸侯复宗周，史称宣王中兴。可是中兴之下，裂缝也在扩大：宣王不修籍田，不听谏言，三十九年千亩之战，王师败绩。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「诸侯复宗周，史称宣王中兴。可是中兴之下，裂缝也在扩大：宣王不修籍田，不听谏言，三十九年千亩之战，王师败绩。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (38–50 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The lords return to Zhou in the Xuan revival, yet cracks widen until the royal army is defeated at Qianmu. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「诸侯复宗周，史称宣王中兴。可是中兴之下，裂缝也在扩大：宣王不修籍田，不听谏言，三十九年千亩之战，王师败绩。」

shots.vo: 薄伐玁狁，至于大原。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（50–56 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」，下署《诗经·小雅·六月》；右下角朱印「中兴」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (50–56 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」 signed 《诗经·小雅·六月》; vermilion seal 「中兴」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、众人呐喊、寂静室内；音效：马蹄声、战鼓、战车、喊杀、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, roaring crowd, quiet room tone; SFX: hoofbeats, war drums, chariots, war cries, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「薄伐玁狁」，副题「宣王中兴」，朱印「中兴」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」——《诗经·小雅·六月》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「薄伐玁狁」, subtitle 「宣王中兴」, vermilion seal 「中兴」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」 — 《诗经·小雅·六月》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

negative.zh: 写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
negative.en: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

narration: 共和十四年之后，太子静即位，就是周宣王。召公、周公二相辅佐他，重修文武之政。
北方的玁狁屡屡南侵，甚至逼近了京畿。
宣王五年三月，王亲自出征，伐玁狁。《诗经》里唱道：六月里军情紧急，戎车已经备好。
卿士兮甲随王出征，斩首执讯，没有伤亡。
他回来以后，铸了一个铜盘——
诸侯复宗周，史称宣王中兴。可是中兴之下，裂缝也在扩大：宣王不修籍田，不听谏言，三十九年千亩之战，王师败绩。
薄伐玁狁，至于大原。

镜头 3（16–26 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：军阵、长兵如林、骑兵、旌旗｜动作：战车六月出征，直抵太原｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；淡墨人影成排，远处虚化；枯笔竖线密如森林；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：战车｜屏幕文字：引文「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宣王五年三月，王亲自出征，伐玁狁。《诗经》里唱道：六月里军情紧急，戎车已经备好。」
镜头 4（26–32 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：尹吉甫、众人、长枪｜动作：尹吉甫斩首执讯，押着俘虏归来｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：众人呐喊；音效：喊杀｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「卿士兮甲随王出征，斩首执讯，没有伤亡。」
镜头 5（32–38 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：伐玁狁；飞白题字「中兴」｜动作：铜盘上铸下了这一次出征｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：喊杀、青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他回来以后，铸了一个铜盘——」
镜头 6（38–50 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：诸侯复宗周，史称宣王中兴。可是中兴之下，裂缝也在扩大：宣王不修籍田，不听谏言，三十九年千亩之战，王师败绩。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「诸侯复宗周，史称宣王中兴。可是中兴之下，裂缝也在扩大：宣王不修籍田，不听谏言，三十九年千亩之战，王师败绩。」
镜头 7（50–56 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」，下署《诗经·小雅·六月》；右下角朱印「中兴」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「薄伐玁狁」，副题「宣王中兴」，朱印「中兴」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」——《诗经·小雅·六月》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
