prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE) · Striking the Xianyun: King Xuan's Revival (「薄伐玁狁」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 56 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), 823 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

Characters:
- Zhou Xuanwang (周宣王) — ruler, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence
- Yin Jifu (尹吉甫) — general, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Nan Zhong (南仲) — general, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Shao Mugong (召穆公) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: sand; subject: cavalry | Action: Xianyun horsemen raise dust on the northern plateau | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; dry-brush scumbled sand; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「薄伐玁狁」 with vermilion seal 「中兴」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「共和十四年之后，太子静即位，就是周宣王。召公、周公二相辅佐他，重修文武之政。」
Shot 2 (10–16 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhou Xuanwang, banners | Action: At Hao the young King Xuan dons armour and mounts his chariot | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北方的玁狁屡屡南侵，甚至逼近了京畿。」
Shot 3 (16–26 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: army ranks, forest of spears, cavalry, banners | Action: In the sixth month the chariots ride out to Taiyuan | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; rows of pale ink figures fading into distance; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: chariots | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宣王五年三月，王亲自出征，伐玁狁。《诗经》里唱道：六月里军情紧急，戎车已经备好。」
Shot 4 (26–32 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Yin Jifu, crowd, spear | Action: Yin Jifu returns with heads and captives | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: war cries | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「卿士兮甲随王出征，斩首执讯，没有伤亡。」
Shot 5 (32–38 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 伐玁狁; dry-brush calligraphy 「中兴」 | Action: The campaign is cast on a bronze basin | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: war cries, bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他回来以后，铸了一个铜盘——」
Shot 6 (38–50 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The lords return to Zhou in the Xuan revival, yet cracks widen until the royal army is defeated at Qianmu. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「诸侯复宗周，史称宣王中兴。可是中兴之下，裂缝也在扩大：宣王不修籍田，不听谏言，三十九年千亩之战，王师败绩。」
Shot 7 (50–56 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」 signed 《诗经·小雅·六月》; vermilion seal 「中兴」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, roaring crowd, quiet room tone; SFX: hoofbeats, war drums, chariots, war cries, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「薄伐玁狁」, subtitle 「宣王中兴」, vermilion seal 「中兴」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「薄伐玁狁，至于大原。」 — 《诗经·小雅·六月》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.xizhou.haojing.title: 烽火
strings.scene.xizhou.haojing.subtitle: 镐京之变
strings.vo.01: 周幽王嬖爱褒姒，废申后与太子宜臼。
strings.vo.02: 《史记》说：褒姒不好笑，幽王万方故不笑。
strings.vo.03: 王举烽火，诸侯悉至，至而无寇，褒姒乃大笑。其后数举，诸侯益亦不至。
strings.vo.04: 申侯怒，联合缯国与犬戎攻周。幽王举烽火征兵，兵莫至。
strings.scene.xizhou.haojing.fork.prompt: 烽火——依《史记》直书，还是听异说「清华简《系年》」？
strings.scene.xizhou.haojing.canon.intro: 骊山上的烽燧已经点过太多次。今天来的是真寇，诸侯的兵马还会来吗？
strings.scene.xizhou.haojing.end.canon: 幽王死于骊山之下，镐京残破。次年，平王东迁洛邑，西周亡，东周始。
strings.scene.xizhou.haojing.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自出土文献清华简《系年》，它的叙述与《史记》不同，没有烽火戏诸侯的情节。学界仍在讨论。
strings.scene.xizhou.haojing.legend.intro: 《系年》说：幽王起兵围平王于西申，申人不交出平王，缯人于是联合西戎攻幽王，幽王与伯盘一同被灭。
strings.scene.xizhou.haojing.end.legend: 叙述不同，结局相同：幽王身死，周室东迁。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：橄榄绿、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 西周 · 周幽王十一年（前 771 年）。宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。
setting.en: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), 771 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

characters.name: 周幽王
characters.zh: 周幽王（周·姬宫湦）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；嬖褒姒，废申后与太子，死于骊山之下
characters.en: Zhou Youwang (周幽王) — ruler, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence

characters.name: 褒姒
characters.zh: 褒姒（周·幽王宠妃）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；《史记》载其不好笑
characters.en: Bao Si (褒姒) — royal / consort, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments

characters.name: 申侯
characters.zh: 申侯（申·申国之君）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩，皮甲与青铜戈；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；与缯、犬戎攻幽王
characters.en: Shen Hou (申侯) — ruler, Shen; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence

characters.name: 宜臼
characters.zh: 宜臼（周·太子，后之周平王）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；被废，奔申，后东迁洛邑
characters.en: Yi Jiu (宜臼) — royal / consort, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments

characters.name: 虢石父
characters.zh: 虢石父（周·卿士）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；《史记》称其佞巧
characters.en: Guo Shifu (虢石父) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents

characters.name: 犬戎
characters.zh: 犬戎（犬戎·西戎）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩，皮甲与青铜戈；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；攻破镐京
characters.en: Quan Rong (犬戎) — commoner, Quan Rong; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate

shots.vo: 周幽王嬖爱褒姒，废申后与太子宜臼。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–6 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山、皴法山石；中景：近山与地面｜动作：骊山之上，烽燧一座｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「烽火」竖排书法与朱印「骊山之下」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「周幽王嬖爱褒姒，废申后与太子宜臼。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, textured rocks; midground: near hills and ground | Action: A beacon tower on Mount Li | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「烽火」 with vermilion seal 「骊山之下」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「周幽王嬖爱褒姒，废申后与太子宜臼。」

shots.vo: 《史记》说：褒姒不好笑，幽王万方故不笑。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（6–12 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：周幽王、褒姒｜动作：褒姒不笑｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；重墨立柱，空间纵深｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：琴弦一拨｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「《史记》说：褒姒不好笑，幽王万方故不笑。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (6–12 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhou Youwang, Bao Si | Action: Bao Si does not smile | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: single guqin pluck | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「《史记》说：褒姒不好笑，幽王万方故不笑。」

shots.vo: 王举烽火，诸侯悉至，至而无寇，褒姒乃大笑。其后数举，诸侯益亦不至。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（12–20 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：火、骑兵｜动作：烽火举，诸侯至，而无寇｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；泼墨成火，焰尖点朱砂；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；热浪与烟气扭曲；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：号角、马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「王举烽火，诸侯悉至，至而无寇，褒姒乃大笑。其后数举，诸侯益亦不至。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (12–20 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: fire (splashed ink), cavalry | Action: The beacon is lit, the lords arrive, but there is no enemy | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; splashed ink flames tipped with vermilion; ink spatters where hooves strike; heat-haze and smoke distortion; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: horn, hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「王举烽火，诸侯悉至，至而无寇，褒姒乃大笑。其后数举，诸侯益亦不至。」

shots.vo: 申侯怒，联合缯国与犬戎攻周。幽王举烽火征兵，兵莫至。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（20–27 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：中景：烟；主体：申侯、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：申侯与犬戎来攻，再举烽火，兵莫至｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；淡墨人影成排，远处虚化；枯笔竖线密如森林｜声音：环境：暴风雨；音效：远处鼓声、兵刃相击｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「申侯怒，联合缯国与犬戎攻周。幽王举烽火征兵，兵莫至。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (20–27 s, 7 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: smoke; subject: Shen Hou, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: The Marquis of Shen and the Quanrong attack; the beacon is lit again and no one comes | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; rows of pale ink figures fading into distance; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: storm; SFX: distant drums, clashing weapons | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「申侯怒，联合缯国与犬戎攻周。幽王举烽火征兵，兵莫至。」

shots.vo: 骊山之下——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（27–33 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：飞白题字「骊山一笔」｜动作：骊山之下｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：火声；音效：烈火｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「骊山之下——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (27–33 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: dry-brush calligraphy 「骊山一笔」 | Action: At the foot of Mount Li | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: fire; SFX: roaring fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「骊山之下——」

shots.vo: 幽王死于骊山之下，镐京残破。次年，平王东迁洛邑，西周亡，东周始。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（33–41 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：幽王死于骊山之下，镐京残破。次年，平王东迁洛邑，西周亡，东周始。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「幽王死于骊山之下，镐京残破。次年，平王东迁洛邑，西周亡，东周始。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (33–41 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: King You dies below Mount Li and Hao is ruined; King Ping moves east to Luoyi and Western Zhou ends. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「幽王死于骊山之下，镐京残破。次年，平王东迁洛邑，西周亡，东周始。」

shots.zh: 镜头 7（41–47 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「骊山之下」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处
shots.en: Shot 7 (41–47 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「骊山之下」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

sound.zh: 背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、远处厮杀声、暴风雨、火声；音效：琴弦一拨、号角、马蹄声、远处鼓声、兵刃相击、烈火；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, distant battle, storm, fire; SFX: single guqin pluck, horn, hoofbeats, distant drums, clashing weapons, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「烽火」，副题「镐京之变」，朱印「骊山之下」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「烽火」, subtitle 「镐京之变」, vermilion seal 「骊山之下」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

negative.zh: 写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
negative.en: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

narration: 周幽王嬖爱褒姒，废申后与太子宜臼。
《史记》说：褒姒不好笑，幽王万方故不笑。
王举烽火，诸侯悉至，至而无寇，褒姒乃大笑。其后数举，诸侯益亦不至。
申侯怒，联合缯国与犬戎攻周。幽王举烽火征兵，兵莫至。
骊山之下——
幽王死于骊山之下，镐京残破。次年，平王东迁洛邑，西周亡，东周始。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】西周 · 烽火（镐京之变）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 47 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

- 虢石父（周·卿士）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；《史记》称其佞巧
- 犬戎（犬戎·西戎）：宽袖深衣，冕服，组玉佩，皮甲与青铜戈；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；攻破镐京

分镜：

镜头 2（6–12 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：周幽王、褒姒｜动作：褒姒不笑｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；重墨立柱，空间纵深｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：琴弦一拨｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「《史记》说：褒姒不好笑，幽王万方故不笑。」

镜头 4（20–27 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：中景：烟；主体：申侯、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：申侯与犬戎来攻，再举烽火，兵莫至｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；淡墨人影成排，远处虚化；枯笔竖线密如森林｜声音：环境：暴风雨；音效：远处鼓声、兵刃相击｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「申侯怒，联合缯国与犬戎攻周。幽王举烽火征兵，兵莫至。」
镜头 5（27–33 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：飞白题字「骊山一笔」｜动作：骊山之下｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：火声；音效：烈火｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「骊山之下——」
镜头 6（33–41 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：幽王死于骊山之下，镐京残破。次年，平王东迁洛邑，西周亡，东周始。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「幽王死于骊山之下，镐京残破。次年，平王东迁洛邑，西周亡，东周始。」
镜头 7（41–47 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「骊山之下」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处

声音：背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、远处厮杀声、暴风雨、火声；音效：琴弦一拨、号角、马蹄声、远处鼓声、兵刃相击、烈火；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「烽火」，副题「镐京之变」，朱印「骊山之下」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE) · Beacon Fires: the Fall of Hao (「烽火」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 47 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained olive and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Western Zhou (1046–771 BCE), 771 BCE — ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns.

Characters:
- Zhou Youwang (周幽王) — ruler, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence
- Bao Si (褒姒) — royal / consort, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Shen Hou (申侯) — ruler, Shen; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence
- Yi Jiu (宜臼) — royal / consort, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Guo Shifu (虢石父) — minister, Zhou; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Quan Rong (犬戎) — commoner, Quan Rong; wide-sleeved shenyi robes, ceremonial mian crowns, jade pendant sets, leather armour and bronze ge; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, textured rocks; midground: near hills and ground | Action: A beacon tower on Mount Li | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「烽火」 with vermilion seal 「骊山之下」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「周幽王嬖爱褒姒，废申后与太子宜臼。」
Shot 2 (6–12 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhou Youwang, Bao Si | Action: Bao Si does not smile | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: single guqin pluck | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「《史记》说：褒姒不好笑，幽王万方故不笑。」
Shot 3 (12–20 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: fire (splashed ink), cavalry | Action: The beacon is lit, the lords arrive, but there is no enemy | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; splashed ink flames tipped with vermilion; ink spatters where hooves strike; heat-haze and smoke distortion; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: horn, hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「王举烽火，诸侯悉至，至而无寇，褒姒乃大笑。其后数举，诸侯益亦不至。」
Shot 4 (20–27 s, 7 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: smoke; subject: Shen Hou, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: The Marquis of Shen and the Quanrong attack; the beacon is lit again and no one comes | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; rows of pale ink figures fading into distance; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: storm; SFX: distant drums, clashing weapons | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「申侯怒，联合缯国与犬戎攻周。幽王举烽火征兵，兵莫至。」
Shot 5 (27–33 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: dry-brush calligraphy 「骊山一笔」 | Action: At the foot of Mount Li | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: fire; SFX: roaring fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「骊山之下——」
Shot 6 (33–41 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: King You dies below Mount Li and Hao is ruined; King Ping moves east to Luoyi and Western Zhou ends. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「幽王死于骊山之下，镐京残破。次年，平王东迁洛邑，西周亡，东周始。」
Shot 7 (41–47 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「骊山之下」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, distant battle, storm, fire; SFX: single guqin pluck, horn, hoofbeats, distant drums, clashing weapons, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「烽火」, subtitle 「镐京之变」, vermilion seal 「骊山之下」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups
